rationale: Eligible eager exact RHF frame responses retain GPU priority and automatically admit bounded FP64 RAM for omitted buckets. Machine/cgroup headroom, remaining complete numeric capacity and free VRAM constrain admission. Full GPU residency allocates no host tier; capacity refusal preserves GPU values and later mandatory OOM retries once without either tier. Independent final residual and derivative sources remain authoritative.
revisit_condition: Qualify changes to source eligibility, staging, bucket selection and resource reserve against same-source complete consuming energy/force endpoints and independent scientific gates. This policy does not qualify RHF-SCF graphs, public prepared CPKS, screened Krylov actions or temporary disk.
